header.title: TenthMatrix WSL Vault
header.subtitle: Steal the server. Not the secrets.
header.description: Open-source, self-hosted secrets management built on AES-256-GCM envelope encryption and a per-tenant key hierarchy — so a stolen disk, database dump, or compromised host still leaves attackers with ciphertext they cannot open.

intro.title: What is WSLVault?
intro.body: WSLVault is a Vault-compatible secrets platform for operators who want encrypted-at-rest multi-tenancy without plaintext on disk. Drive it from the steel/brass web console, CLI, Go/Python/Rust/TypeScript SDKs, or MCP — with Helm/GitOps deploy on Kubernetes.

items.title: True multi-tenancy
items.text: Team A cannot decrypt Team B — cryptographic refusal, not an application oops.

items.title: Envelope encryption
items.text: DEK → tenant KEK → root KEK (KMS / HSM / Shamir). Secrets sealed before they touch disk.

items.title: Engines you need
items.text: Versioned KV, transit encryption, PKI, dynamic leases, identity policies, and MFA.

items.title: HA & audit
items.text: Active/active multi-region replication and a tamper-evident, hash-chained audit trail.

features.title: Everything a secret needs, behind one API

items.title: Versioned KV secrets
items.text: Vault-compatible KV v2: versioned reads/writes, check-and-set, soft-delete and destroy — every value sealed before storage.

items.title: Transit engine
items.text: Encrypt, decrypt, sign and verify without plaintext keys leaving the vault. Rotate keys while old ciphertext stays readable.

items.title: PKI & certificates
items.text: Private CA, roles, and short-lived certificates. CA private keys are envelope-encrypted, never stored in the clear.

items.title: Dynamic leases
items.text: Credentials are leases: issued, listed, renewed, and revoked for real. Revoke stops access immediately.

items.title: Identity & MFA
items.text: TOTP two-factor, recovery codes, fine-grained policies on API keys and JWTs — plus SCIM, LDAP, OIDC, mTLS and workload auth.

items.title: Zero plaintext at rest
items.text: A database dump yields ciphertext wrapped under keys the database never sees. Steal the disk ≠ steal the secrets.

deploy.title: Cloud-native and scriptable
deploy.body: Ship with the Helm chart and Kubernetes operator, drive from GitOps, scrape with Prometheus, and reach WSLVault from your language of choice — or from an AI agent over the built-in MCP server.
